## About
We're a neighborhood auto repair and smog check shop on National Blvd in Los Angeles. We started this business on honesty, integrity, being involved in the community and helping the community. We're here to repair cars, but more than that we focus on the customer and try to understand your needs, goals and problems.
Sako and the crew handle everything from oil changes and tune ups to engine, transmission, exhaust, heating and air conditioner work, plus smog checks for cars, diesel trucks and RV smog checks too. Call us for a free evaluation if something doesn't feel right with your car.
We're rated 4.6 from 134 Google reviews. If you have any issue with your vehicle, don't hesitate to call. We'd be happy to help.

## Services
- Smog Check Services: Smog checks for your car, done right here on National Blvd.
- Diesel Truck Smog Check: Smog checks for diesel trucks, and we do RV smog checks too.
- Standard Maintenance Service: Factory scheduled maintenance, oil changes, tune ups, filter replacements, fluid services, brake repair and check engine light diagnostics.
- Engine Services: Engine repair and replacement, engine performance checks, radiator and water pump work, fuel injection, ignition and cooling system repair.
- Transmission Repair: Transmission repair and service, transmission replacement, clutch, axle, driveshaft and differential work.
- Emission Repair: State emission inspections and the repairs to get your car passing.
- Special Services for Uber & Lyft Drivers: Inspections for Uber and Lyft drivers who need their car checked over.
- Heating & Air Conditioner Repair: Heating and cooling diagnostics, air conditioning repair and service, refrigerant replacement, compressor and evaporator work.

## FAQ

Q: Do you do RV smog checks?
A: Yes. We do RV smog checks and diesel truck smog checks along with regular cars.
